reviews.title: Make sure you know this is a modular power Fan
reviews.comment: I don’t know if you need really 1000 W power supplies, kind of overkill, but 850 power supply is one of the best things you can ever get. Honestly, I think this is the best things that they make other than their lights.
reviews.author: Keivon poland

reviews.title: Love it so far!
reviews.comment: I bought this to go with the Lian Li 207 case.  Glad I did.  I am not a patient cable managers.  I allow my self a literal 5 minutes or less to run all cables when I do my build, and this psu + case combo allowed me to have non-embarrassing cable management in about 3 minutes. The performance is good so far, as my 9900x and 4070 super perform flawlessly in all benchmark tests so far.  I do not push this 850w at all, so was expecting no issues.  I definitely do not hear it over my case fans or aio pump, so I assume that means it is quiet; if the fan even runs.  I honestly don't know if it has a fanless option or not, since it has been over a decade since I had a psu I could hear, in which that was the last time that option even meant something to me.
reviews.author: Braden

reviews.title: Great for Lancool 207
reviews.comment: Saved me a lot of trouble in my Lancool 207, my previous psu would not fit as it was too long.  I bought this unit which is 850 watt's compared to my old 1000 watt and have had no issues.  It was easy to setup, quiet, with easy cable management due to the shape.  Modular cables are great with the needed 12vpwr connector native which saved me from using an adapter or buying another cable. I use an Ultra 7 265K 48gb ram, Rx 9070xt, multiple storage drives and multiple case fans with no issue.

reviews.title: Fan whining noise
reviews.comment: When the fan of the PSU start spinning, it would make a whining noise. I did a RMA and received just the PSU (no cables).  The whining noise is still there but not as loud. Looks like they did not fix this, while researching, this has been happening to people for a few years now.
reviews.author: Mark
